data.name: Jitendrakumar
data.gender_notes: Jitendrakumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jitendra: Victor over the Gods. Kumar: Young Prince. The name Jitendrakumar evokes the image of a young, valiant, and victorious prince over the gods. The name Jitendrakumar carries the meaning “Victor over the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jitendrakumar usually hope their child will grow to embody victor over the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with divine power and triumph.
data.etymology: Jitendrakumar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victor over the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jitendrakumar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
